correctness.summary: The sinhc normalization gives an exact positive ordinary curvature at r=-alpha/2 for every unequal pair, contradicting the proposed global concavity. A separate Taylor expansion gives (log[J_alpha(r)J_alpha(-r)])''=-(2 alpha/15)u^4+O(u^6) as the input ratio tends to one, contradicting exterior logarithmic convexity at every fixed exterior parameter.

limitations: The full ordinary-curvature sign diagram of J_alpha is not classified.
The full logarithmic-curvature sign diagram of J_alpha(r)J_alpha(-r) is not classified.
The central clauses of Open Problem 2 are not resolved.
The near-diagonal value 5/6-alpha/2 is asymptotic rather than an exact global inflection point.
A poorly indexed or unpublished prior observation remains a residual originality risk.
Independent audit has not been performed.

originality.scope: to the best of our knowledge
originality.summary: The 2007 source explicitly poses both claims. Exact, synonymous, Stolarsky-mean, hyperbolic-normalization, citation-chain, and recent-survey searches did not locate the counterexamples or curvature expansions. The 2025 Yang-Qi survey revisits the established one-parameter logarithmic-curvature and product-monotonicity results but no resolution of these two curvature questions was found.

review_statement: Same-model review: passed. Independent audit: not yet performed.

value.summary: One published open problem is disproved universally for every admissible parameter and unequal input pair, and a second conjectured curvature regime is disproved by a robust near-diagonal mechanism valid at every prescribed finite exterior parameter.
